projects.name: speech visualization
projects.description: Dashboard showing the features of live recorded or uploaded audio files using machine learning models built using the wav2vec 2.0 model developed by Facebook.
projects.longDescription: We worked on this as semester 5 project in third year. We tried to predict speaker age, gender, emotions, pitch etc from the recorded audio. User can upload pre-recorded audio or record live directly from the dashboard. We used multiple speech datasets and state of the art models for the task. If there are no good models, we tried to build our own models (for example: emotion detection).
